doc.brief: Values that can be passed to the [`Widget.system_setting_changed()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#vfunc:system_setting_changed) vfunc.
doc.md:
Values that can be passed to the [`Widget.system_setting_changed()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#vfunc:system_setting_changed)
vfunc.

The values indicate which system setting has changed.
Widgets may need to drop caches, or react otherwise.

Most of the values correspond to [`Settings`](xref:gtk:Settings) properties.

More values may be added over time.

font_config.brief: The font configuration has changed in a way that requires text to be redrawn.
font_config.md:
The font configuration has changed in a way that
  requires text to be redrawn. This can be any of the
  [`Settings:gtk-xft-antialias`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Settings#property:gtk-xft-antialias),
  [`Settings:gtk-xft-hinting`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Settings#property:gtk-xft-hinting),
  [`Settings:gtk-xft-hintstyle`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Settings#property:gtk-xft-hintstyle),
  [`Settings:gtk-xft-rgba`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Settings#property:gtk-xft-rgba) or
  [`Settings:gtk-fontconfig-timestamp`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Settings#property:gtk-fontconfig-timestamp) settings

icon_theme.brief: The icon theme has changed in a way that requires icons to be looked up again
icon_theme.md:
The icon theme has changed in a way that requires
  icons to be looked up again
